original_source_record: | 11 LowRA | Paper reproduction. Stanford's pinned repository includes a release announcement only. The offline job uses the actual frozen decoder weights, 64-weight absmax groups, two per-channel weighted Lloyd iterations initialized from Appendix F, and the average of the two learned threshold sets. One 128-cluster KMeans per input width precedes the cluster integer program and per-cluster minimum-cost allocation. The latter is solved as an integral transportation LP or exact marginal-cost sort. Budget is 1.75 code bits per decoder-projection weight across 1/2/4-bit output channels. One LoftQ step initializes rank-8 factors using a seeded, two-iteration randomized SVD of the quantization residual. The port has its own Triton unpack kernel with per-channel tables. The audio tower, embeddings and output head retain their original precision. This arm changes the effective base. | [ICML paper](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v267/zhou25ak.html) · [Stanford source snapshot](https://github.com/stanford-ppl/LowRA/tree/2920cd297680e26da5f8648e95a644f953bdd102) |

A missing invocation fails this evaluation. Greedy decoding starts from the full prompt and supports cached single-token continuation.
